# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Model or training config
- [ ] Dataset or preprocessing
- [ ] Inference or deployment
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or CI
- [ ] Refactor

## Testing

List the commands you ran and the results.

```bash

```

## Public Release Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private keys, robot account IDs, private URLs,
  customer names, real site names, or uncensored logs are included
- [ ] No private datasets, checkpoints, training outputs, or local work
  directories are included
- [ ] New third-party code, model assets, images, or datasets include source and
  license information
- [ ] Documentation examples use placeholders instead of real infrastructure
  addresses or accounts
- [ ] Real robot changes document safety assumptions and dry-run behavior
- [ ] Relevant tests, import checks, or dry-run checks were performed

## Real Robot Impact

- [ ] No real robot impact
- [ ] Dry-run or simulation only
- [ ] Real robot execution path changed

If real robot execution is affected, describe the safety validation performed.

## Additional Notes

Add reviewer notes, known limitations, or follow-up items.
